title: BECE Physical Education - Physical & Health Education - Family & Personal Health
subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which class of food is primarily responsible for building and repairing body tissues?
questions.explain: Proteins are essential nutrients that build and repair tissues in the body.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of the following diseases is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C?
questions.explain: Scurvy is caused by a lack of Vitamin C in the diet, leading to swollen gums and bleeding.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The proper disposal of sewage and refuse is known as ________.
questions.explain: Sanitation refers to public health conditions related to clean drinking water and adequate treatment and disposal of human excreta and sewage.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a source of Carbohydrates?
questions.explain: Fish is a primary source of Protein, whereas Yam, Rice, and Cassava are sources of Carbohydrates.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Dental caries is a condition that affects the ________.
questions.explain: Dental caries, also known as tooth decay or cavities, affects the teeth.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Lack of Iodine in the diet can lead to a condition called ________.
questions.explain: Goitre is the enlargement of the thyroid gland caused by iodine deficiency.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of the following is a method of water purification?
questions.explain: Boiling water kills germs and parasites, making it safe for drinking.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A balanced diet must contain all classes of food in ________.
questions.explain: A balanced diet provides essential nutrients in the correct proportions required by the body.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The primary function of Vitamin D in the body is to help in the formation of strong ________.
questions.explain: Vitamin D assists in the absorption of calcium, which is vital for bone and tooth formation.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of these is a vector for Malaria?
questions.explain: The Female Anopheles Mosquito transmits the malaria parasite.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Maintaining personal hygiene helps to prevent ________.
questions.explain: Regular bathing and cleaning prevent bacteria buildup that causes odour and skin infections.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Kwashiorkor is a disease common among children due to a severe deficiency of ________.
questions.explain: Kwashiorkor is a severe form of malnutrition caused by a lack of protein in the diet.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: What is the best way to dispose of non-biodegradable refuse like plastics?
questions.explain: Recycling is the most environmentally friendly method for handling plastics.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which organ of the body is primarily affected by Tuberculosis?
questions.explain: Tuberculosis mainly affects the lungs, causing coughing and breathing difficulties.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: To prevent dehydration, a person should consume adequate amounts of ________.
questions.explain: Water is essential for hydration and bodily functions.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education
